about: Sweet Repeat Resale is at 404 N Main St in Historic Downtown Bryan, right across the street from Tavo Coffee Co.
It specializes in vintage clothes, including letterman jackets, '90s fashion and rare finds, plus accessories, DVDs and knickknacks. Shoppers can bring in their own thrifted goods for cash or trade.
Customers have given it 4.4 stars across 46 Google reviews.
